title: Second register layout
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $R$ be a register record, and let $b,s,wp,pos$ be natural numbers. The second register layout is obtained from $R$ by setting $E2$ and $Q1$ to $b+4W(N)s+2W(N)$, $F2$ to that quantity plus $2wp$, $U$ to that quantity plus $2wp+4$, $Pos2$ to $pos$, and $T$ to $0$. Every other register retains its value from $R$.
